fee_notes: The Franchise Fee is $50,000 per Restaurant. A Pre-Paid Franchise Fee is required under a Development Agreement (minimum 3 Restaurants): 100% of the Franchise Fee ($50,000) for the first Restaurant plus 50% ($25,000) for each additional Restaurant; amounts paid are credited toward the per-unit Franchise Fee. Fridays may, in its discretion, reduce the Franchise Fee as a development incentive, to compensate for unfavorable economic conditions, or for other business purposes.
raw_excerpt: When you sign a Franchise Agreement (Exhibit B), you must pay us the initial Franchise Fee in the amount of $50,000 (the "Franchise Fee").  If you paid a Pre-Paid Franchise Agreement, the applicable amount will be credited toward payment of the Franchise Fee.  The Franchise Fee is fully earned when paid and is not refundable.  We may, in our discretion, reduce the Franchise Fee as a development incentive for selected developers to accelerate development, to compensate for unfavorable economic conditions, or for any other business purpose.  Except in these limited circumstances, the Franchise Fee will be uniformly imposed.
